name: task-relations
title: Task relations
description: Task dependencies in groups: blocked by, blocks and related, each with its status and an add-link action.
docs: relations is { blockedBy, blocks, related }, each a list of tasks { id, key, title, status, href } with a status of todo, in-progress, in-review, done or cancelled, drawn as a ring, a half ring, a three-quarter ring, a solid disc with a tick and a ring with a slash, and always written out. Empty groups are not drawn. A task with open blockers says so at the top (Blocked by 2 open tasks, a polite status) and its resolved blockers (done or cancelled) fold away behind Show 2 resolved. With canEdit, Add link opens a small searchable menu over candidates (those already linked are left out) with the kind of link to make; onAdd(kind, task) may return a promise: the picked row then shows a spinner, the rest wait and a second pick does nothing, and a rejection keeps the menu open and says so. Every row gets a remove button that asks first in a confirmation; onRemove(kind, task) may return a promise. Both are announced, and focus lands on the panel when a row disappears. onOpen(task, event) makes rows open: with href the title is a link and the event reaches your router, without it the row is a button. The panel reads its own width: narrow, the status moves under the title. headingLevel (2 to 4) sets the heading and the group names sit one level below. labels translates every word.
